claude_cli.edits: claude -p 'TASK' --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Read,Glob,Grep,Bash,Edit,Write --strict-mcp-config --no-chrome --output-format text
notes: In every edit prompt, explicitly forbid commit, push, and deploy.
--strict-mcp-config --no-chrome avoids an observed optional-MCP startup hang.
Print output is buffered until completion (no streaming).
Do NOT use --bare: it requires API-key auth, which breaks normal subscription OAuth.

genspark_cli.do_not_use: genspark task create super_agent (does not guarantee model selection)
genspark_cli.per_run: gsk_run_data=$(mktemp -d); XDG_DATA_HOME="$gsk_run_data/data" XDG_STATE_HOME="$gsk_run_data/state" OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT="$(jq -c 'del(.genspark)' "$gsk_cfg_dir/opencode.json")" opencode run --model genspark-llm-proxy/gpt-5.6-sol --agent plan --dir /Users/stevencommander/Desktop/AI/op-patchstudio-improved 'READ-ONLY TASK'
notes: The generated opencode.json contains an API key: NEVER print, cat, echo, log, or share it.
del(.genspark) is required because the installed stock OpenCode rejects the generated extra key.
Fresh XDG dirs per run avoid an observed local SQLite replacement_seq schema mismatch.
